types.name: WWorldPos

fields.name: vertex0
fields.comment: medium: face vertex 0: MakeFaceAtPoint(d2f10) copies p.xyz to +0x0/+0x4/+0x8; ctor d2fd0 copies the zero COORD3 at 0x243030. +0xc never touched (16-byte stride on both builds; PS2 +0x0/+0x8 w8/w4). Name invented

fields.name: vertex1
fields.comment: medium: MakeFaceAtPoint stores (p.x+C, p.y, p.z) with C=[0x18a498]; ctor 'LEA EDX,[EAX+0x10]' + zero COORD3; PS2 +0x10 same. Name invented

fields.name: vertex2
fields.comment: medium: MakeFaceAtPoint stores (p.x, p.y, p.z+C); ctor LEA +0x20 + zero COORD3; PS2 +0x20 same. 12 bytes only: +0x2c is a byte field on both builds. Name invented

fields.name: faceType
fields.comment: low: MakeFaceAtPoint writes 1 (low byte of a word store with +0x2d=0), ctor 0; PS2 sb +0x2c in both. Meaning unknown, name invented

fields.name: faceSubType
fields.comment: low: ctor/MakeFaceAtPoint write 0; PS2 sb +0x2d. Name invented

fields.name: faceId
fields.comment: low: WORD store of 0 in ctor and MakeFaceAtPoint; PS2 sh +0x2e. Name invented

fields.name: faceValid
fields.comment: medium: byte on Xbox (ctor 0, MakeFaceAtPoint 1, read by all FindClosestFace/HeightAtPoint), word on PS2 (+0x30, same method set): PS2 4-byte bool; the next field stays at +0x34 on both, so no drift. Name invented

fields.name: cacheStamp
fields.comment: low: MakeFaceAtPoint stores *(*(0x239a70)+8) (a global counter/stamp), ctor 0; R/W in the three FindClosestFace overloads; PS2 +0x34 same methods. Name invented

fields.name: unknown_38
fields.comment: low: ctor and MakeFaceAtPoint zero it; R/W in FindClosestFace x3; PS2 +0x38 same. Possibly a cached face/instance pointer

fields.name: unknown_3c
fields.comment: low: ctor zeroes it; written by the two list-taking FindClosestFace overloads (d3110, d31f0); PS2 +0x3c written by 2322c8/232638

types.comment: cached ground face: three vertices at a 16-byte stride + face data; same layout on PS2 and Xbox except the 1-byte bool at +0x30

types.name: WCollider

fields.name: position
fields.comment: medium: ctors be540/be620 and Refresh x2 write xyz (ctor from the zero COORD3 0x243030, then Refresh(COORD3&,float)); PS2 +0x0 w8 + +0x8 w4 (unpadded COORD3 on PS2 too). Sheet: Refresh(COORD3&,float)/Refresh(COORD4*) - the sphere xyz. Name invented

fields.name: radius
fields.comment: medium: ctor zeroes, Refresh writes float; PS2 +0xc float. Completes a COORD4-style sphere with +0x0. Name invented

fields.name: prevPosition
fields.comment: low: ctor 'LEA EDX,[ESI+0x10]' + zero COORD3, Refresh x2 write; PS2 +0x10 w8/+0x18 w4. Second sphere, probably the previous position for the swept region. Name invented

fields.name: prevRadius
fields.comment: low: ctor 0, Refresh R/W float; PS2 +0x1c float. Name invented

fields.name: regionCentre
fields.comment: medium: ctor LEA +0x20 + zero COORD3; PrepareRegion/Refresh use it; PS2 +0x20 float (InRegion x2, PrepareRegion, Refresh). Third sphere = region bounding the two above (InRegion tests against it). Name invented

fields.name: regionRadius
fields.comment: medium: ctor 0; float R/W in InRegion(bd820), PrepareRegion, Refresh; address also taken (LEA +0x2c). PS2 +0x2c float, same methods. Name invented

fields.name: list0First
fields.comment: medium: MSVC std::vector (16 bytes: allocator at +0, then first/last/end) - ctors/dtor/Clear zero or free it; Validate(bd750) walks [+0x34,+0x38) in 8-byte records {a,b} and requires b==0 || b->+0x10 == a->+0x1c; GetWorldNormal/PrepareRegion take its

fields.name: list0Last
fields.comment: medium: see list0First

fields.name: list0End
fields.comment: medium: see list0First; ctor zeroes it, dtor frees

fields.name: list1First
fields.comment: medium: MSVC std::vector (16 bytes: allocator at +0, then first/last/end) - ctors/dtor/Clear; GetWorldNormal and PrepareRegion read +0x44/+0x48; PrepareRegion takes +0x40. PS2 vector at +0x3c (+0x40 read by GetWorldNormal). Allocator dword left undef

fields.name: list1Last
fields.comment: medium: see list1First

fields.name: list1End
fields.comment: medium: see list1First; ctor zeroes it, dtor frees

fields.name: list2First
fields.comment: medium: MSVC std::vector (16 bytes: allocator at +0, then first/last/end) - ctors/dtor/Clear; Validate walks [+0x54,+0x58) in 8-byte records {a,b*} requiring *b==a; PrepareRegion takes +0x50. PS2 vector at +0x48 (+0x4c read by Validate). Allocator dw

fields.name: list2Last
fields.comment: medium: see list2First

fields.name: list2End
fields.comment: medium: see list2First; ctor zeroes it, dtor frees

fields.name: regionValid
fields.comment: medium: byte; ctor be540 stores 0; Validate returns false immediately when clear; Clear/PrepareRegion/Refresh(be4b0) touch it. PS2 +0x54 word (4-byte bool) in the same methods. Name invented

fields.name: flag61
fields.comment: medium: byte = the ctor's bool argument (be540: 'MOV DL,[EBP+0x10]; MOV [ESI+0x61],DL'); read in PrepareRegion. PS2 +0x58 word (ctors, PrepareRegion). Name invented

fields.name: collisionMask
fields.comment: medium: = the ctor's unsigned int argument (be540 [EBP+0x14] -> +0x64); byte tests and dword reads in InRegion x2, GetWorldNormal, PrepareRegion, Refresh. PS2 +0x5c. Name invented (sheet parameter is 'unsigned int')

types.comment: sphere collider (current, previous, region spheres), three MSVC vectors, two bools and a collision mask; PS2 0x60 bytes

types.name: Simulation

fields.name: random
fields.comment: high: ctor: FastAlloc(0x10) + ctor 0x5cc80, stored to [EBP]; dtor deletes via a folded dtor; PS2 +0x0 loaded and passed to SimRandom::~SimRandom. Name invented

fields.name: useScratchPad
fields.comment: medium: byte on Xbox, word on PS2 (4-byte bool); GetRigidBody(b2700) picks +0x28 when set, else +0x1c; PS2 CopyRigidBodiesFromScratchPad uses +0x4. No drift after it (+0x8 same on both). Name invented

fields.name: numRigidBodies
fields.comment: high: AssignRigidBodySlot 'INC [ECX+0x8]' on the rigid-body path, CanSpawnRigidBody reads it, Reset writes; PS2 +0x8 same. Name invented

fields.name: numSimpleRigidBodies
fields.comment: high: AssignRigidBodySlot 'INC [ECX+0xc]' on the simple path; CanSpawnSimpleRigidBody/ReleaseRigidBodySlot; PS2 +0xc. Name invented

fields.name: bodyPoolSize
fields.comment: high: ctor = 0x17800 and passed as the size of the +0x18 allocation and its memset; PS2 +0x10 ctor. Name invented

fields.name: scratchPadFreeZone
fields.comment: medium: ctor = 0x3800; PS2 GetScratchPadFreeZone returns +0x14. Name from the PS2 method

fields.name: bodyPool
fields.comment: high: ctor stores the 0x17800-byte block from 0x114470 and zero-fills it; dtor frees; PS2 +0x18. Name invented

fields.name: rigidBodies
fields.comment: high: = bodyPool; GetRigidBody returns +0x1c + id*0x80 (64 slots * 0x80 = 0x2000); PS2 +0x1c. Name invented

fields.name: simpleRigidBodies
fields.comment: high: = bodyPool+0x2000 (96 * 0x40 = 0x1800); GetSimpleRigidBody/DetectCollisionsSRB/ReleaseRigidBodySlot; PS2 +0x20. Name invented

fields.name: rigidBodyInfo
fields.comment: high: = bodyPool+0x3800; GetRigidBodyInfo returns +0x24 + id*0x500 (64*0x500 ends exactly at 0x17800); PS2 +0x24. Element type unknown. Name invented

fields.name: rigidBodiesScratch
fields.comment: medium: ctor 0; GetRigidBody uses it when useScratchPad; PS2 +0x28 passed to DMA_FromScratchPad. Name invented

fields.name: simpleRigidBodiesScratch
fields.comment: medium: ctor 0; GetSimpleRigidBody/DetectCollisionsSRB counterpart of +0x28; PS2 +0x2c. Name invented

fields.name: rigidBodySigs
fields.comment: high: ctor REP STOSD 0x40 dwords; AssignRigidBodySlot stores the signature (slot<<24 | counter) at [ECX+EAX*4+0x30], 64 slots. PS2 +0x30 has only 48 entries (0xc0): Xbox raised the rigid-body limit. Name invented

fields.name: simpleRigidBodySigs
fields.comment: high: ctor REP STOSD 0x60; AssignRigidBodySlot(simple) stores sig|0x80000000 at +0x130+i*4, 96 slots. PS2 +0xf0 (also 96). Name invented

fields.name: rigidBodyOwners
fields.comment: high: AssignRigidBodySlot searches the first null of 0x40 entries at +0x2b0 and stores the PhysicsObject* argument; SimulateGame iterates it. PS2 +0x270 (48 entries). Name invented

fields.name: simpleRigidBodyOwners
fields.comment: high: AssignRigidBodySlot(simple) searches 0x60 entries at +0x3b0 and stores the owner; DetectCollisionsSRB. PS2 +0x330. Name invented

fields.name: srbPairs
fields.comment: low: ctor zero-fills 0x900 bytes as 288 8-byte records ([+0x530],[+0x534]=0 then MOVSD 0x23e dwords); DetectCollisionsSRB takes its address. PS2 +0x4b0 (same 0x900 size). Element type unknown, name invented

fields.name: savedSimState
fields.comment: high: PauseSimState copies simState here before setting it to 3; UnPauseSimState restores it; PS2 +0xdb0. Name invented

fields.name: simState
fields.comment: high: 3 = paused (PauseSimState/UnPauseSimState/AdvanceStep compare with 3); SimulateGame/Reset; PS2 +0xdb4. Name invented

fields.name: unknown_e3c
fields.comment: low: ctor and Reset zero it; PS2 +0xdbc (ctor)

fields.name: unknown_e40
fields.comment: low: float, ctor and Reset write 0; PS2 +0xdc0

fields.name: stepCount
fields.comment: high: AdvanceStep 'INC [ECX+0xe44]' unless paused; Reset writes; PS2 +0xdc4 (AdvanceStep). Name invented

fields.name: reflectiveObjectSig
fields.comment: medium: ctor 0; PS2 +0xdc8 read/written by Get/SetReflectiveObject(SimObjSig) (no separate Xbox functions). Name from PS2 methods
